selectionMethod.stageA: OKX crypto USDT perpetuals + Binance USDⓈ-M perpetuals -> product purification -> cross-exchange confirmation -> liquidity + OI + volatility

purification.okxRuleType: normal/rebase_contract only; pre_market/xperp futures are not part of SWAP discovery

selectionMethod.stageB: layered scheduler: BTC/ETH/SOL core remains first; cached-only/watch candidates receive bounded price+taker+OI anomaly rechecks; multi-field anomalies may enter the five full fresh 15m/1h slots
selectionMethod.finalModelLayer: BTC/ETH environment fit + structure/MA direction + Volume Profile location + OI/CVD/Volume/Taker capital evidence + 5m trigger + failure + R:R + explicit entry mode

dataQuality.retryPolicy: 3 attempts; 429/5xx/50011 exponential backoff + jitter; non-retryable 4xx fail fast
dataQuality.publishOrder: latest.json -> model_signals.json -> summary.json -> bitget_evidence_state.json; shared runId; /run uses bounded_manual_full and emits run_status.json on caught failure
dataQuality.githubConflictRetry: 409/422 -> refetch SHA and retry up to 2 times

evidencePolicy.cvd: Binance 5m closed klines using takerBuyVolume vs implied takerSellVolume; unavailable is never fabricated and is not a hard veto
evidencePolicy.volumeProfile: 15m/1h closed-candle approximate price-volume distribution, 48-bar lookback, POC/VAH/VAL/HVN/LVN
evidencePolicy.auxiliaryConflictPolicy: auxiliary conflicts downgrade confidence only; hard veto reserved for broken main chain, invalid failure condition, bad R:R, or systemic risk
